name: ANSI/IEEE tachometer symbol
summary: IEEE-library tachometer instrument form showing where machine speed is indicated from a speed transducer.
description: The tachometer form shows an indicating instrument whose quantity is rotational speed. In motor and generator control schematics it is normally fed from a tacho-generator, pulse pickup or drive analogue output, so the source device is drawn separately and wired to the instrument circle.

The circle does not say whether speed is displayed in rpm, percent of rated speed or frequency, and it carries no overspeed protection function. Overspeed or underspeed trips use separate devices or contacts and should not be inferred from the presence of a tachometer.
readingNotes: Identify the speed source feeding the meter.
Check scaling between transducer output and displayed speed.
distinction: A tachometer indicates speed; a tachometric dynamo or pulse pickup is the transducer that produces the speed signal.
